column3: HexTow AS4 PAN carbon fiber constituent
column5: These are fiber constituent properties, not the separate HexPly 8552 composite table on the same sheet. No resin system, fiber volume fraction, cured ply, sizing, tow count, matched specimens or exact test temperature is selected by these values. Explicit engineering-reference-model=1 and material-form-fiber=1 are required. No temperature validity interval, isotropy or transverse elastic constants are inferred.

column4: Producer SI column, tensile chord modulus 6000-1000
column5: The printed SI-column strength and modulus are retained. Tensile failure strain is not a complete stress-strain curve, and strength does not create a failure law. Source strain-rate and test temperature are unstated. Fiber tensile properties cannot fill a generic isotropic Young modulus request.

column3: HexTow AS4 yarn/tow thermal and electrical reference
column4: Producer metric column; direction and temperature unspecified
column5: Thermal conductivity, electrical resistivity and expansion are explicitly direction-unspecified properties. A longitudinal or transverse value is not inferred from the fiber shape. The expansion coefficient has no stated averaging interval or instantaneous convention and is stored only as a reported coefficient. Electrical resistivity converts ohm cm to ohm m by 0.01.

The producer metric entry is 0.27 cal/(g C); the authored conversion uses 1 cal = 4.184 J and 1 g = .001 kg. The source does not identify a calorie convention. Thermochemical-calorie-conversion=1 records this interpretation; the paired rounded Btu column is not averaged into the metric value.
